steps: Before and after express opposite positions in time.

questions.prompt: My father makes wooden tables, desks, chairs and beds. What is he? (a Mason, b carpenter, c plumber, d cobbler)
steps: A carpenter makes and repairs wooden objects.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Pupils were bitten by a ___ of bees. (a Flock, b crowd, c swam, d gang)
steps: The collective noun is swarm; bees normally sting rather than bite.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: c, intended swarm (the source misspells it swam).

questions.prompt: Grace is ___ a letter. (a Writes, b wrote, c written, d writing)
steps: Is plus writing forms the present continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My friend will come ___ 8 o'clock. (a From, b by, c at, d in)
steps: At specifies the arrival time; by is grammatical with a different deadline meaning.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: c. At (exact time); b. by means no later than 8.

questions.prompt: My sister and I ___ to school every day. (a Went, b go, c goes, d gone)
steps: The plural subject uses go for a habitual present action.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: An elephant is ___ than a buffalo. (a Big, b biggest, c bigger, d big big)
steps: Than requires the comparative adjective.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Was there ___ sugar in the tea? (a Much, b any, c some, d a few)
steps: Sugar is uncountable. Any asks whether sugar was present; much asks about a large amount and some can expect a yes.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: b. Any (neutral question); much/some are possible with other meanings.
